title: Message to a trusted adult
body:
Hi [trusted adult's name],

I need your help with something serious. Someone shared or made a fake/harmful image or video of [classmate's name], and I'm not sure what to do next.

I have saved what I can (screenshots / links / usernames / when I first saw it). Can we talk soon about how to report this safely and who else should know?

Thank you,
[your name]
